items.title: It’s fixed! №118
items.summary: Today, we’ve rounded up and will be covering some of the fixes and improvements that we’ve made to the game today and over the past weeks. If you’d like to catch up on every fixed bug, then be sure to check…

items.title: Update 2.59.0.54
items.summary: Bomber Damage Model: Collision damage between aircraft has been increased. Previously collisions resulted in insufficient damage of wings and tail and didn’t lead to their separation. Added a chance for fuel…

items.title: Update 2.59.0.49
items.summary: A bug that caused wheeled ground vehicles to shake when losing all wheels on one side has been fixed.

items.title: Update 2.59.0.46
items.summary: PGZ88 — the excessively high volume of the cannons has been reduced.
